connector.name: Cookie MCP
connector.registryDescription: Cookie Chain tools for AI agents: swap, launch, liquidity, staking, NFTs, and a Solana bridge.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cookie-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cookiechain account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: COOKIE_RPC_URL
env.description: Cookie Chain RPC endpoint. Defaults to the public Cookiescan RPC (https://rpc.cookiescan.io).

env.name: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Wallet key for money-moving tools (base58 secret, solana-keygen JSON array, or a path to a keypair file). Optional — without it the server runs read-only and money-moving tools return a clear error. The key is used only to sign locally and is redacted from all output.

env.name: COOKIE_MAX_TRADE_COOK
env.description: Hard per-transaction spend cap in COOK; money-moving tools refuse inputs valued above it (0 disables). Defaults to 100.

env.name: COOKIE_SLIPPAGE_BPS
env.description: Default slippage tolerance in basis points (500 = 5%). Defaults to 500.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Solana mainnet RPC endpoint, used only by the bridge tool. Defaults to the public endpoint, which is rate-limited; a dedicated RPC is recommended for reliable bridging.
